exposure: Severe polyhydramnios group (amniotic fluid index > 35 cm)
Nonsevere polyhydramnios group (amniotic fluid index 24-34 cm)
finding: An increased myocardial performance index in fetuses with idiopathic polyhydramnios was independently associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including nonreassuring fetal status, emergency cesarean delivery, and respiratory distress syndrome.
mod_finding: An increased myocardial performance index in fetuses with idiopathic polyhydramnios was independently associated with emergency cesarean delivery.
